# danish: Jeg hedder Anna. Hvad hedder du?
english: My name is Anna. What is your name?

# danish: Det er rart at møde dig.
english: It is nice to meet you.

# danish: Jeg kommer fra England, men jeg bor i Danmark.
english: I come from England, but I live in Denmark.

# danish: Jeg forstår ikke det sidste ord.
english: I do not understand the last word.
Would you speak a little more slowly?

# danish: Hvordan siger man det på dansk?
english: How do you say that in Danish?
No, I do not know that.

# danish: Jo, jeg kan godt forstå dig.
english: Yes, I can understand you. (Contradicting a negative.)
